rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a mild drift lower with declining closes and a pickup in sell-side volume on the final bar, but price is sitting in the lower third of today's range (31.8%) with no clear momentum signal in either direction — the 9-EMA and VWAP are tightly clustered just below current price, offering no clean structural edge. While relative volume is extremely elevated (25.76x), the gap from prior close is negligible and SPY is essentially flat, so the volume surge likely reflects a one-time event (news/dividend/index rebalance) rather than a directional catalyst I can exploit with a defined risk/reward setup. With today already showing a small realized loss, the risk/reward does not justify entry without a clearer directional thesis.
